topic: A teacher receives an unexpected gift from a former student
text: I just don't understand why people can't express gratitude in simpler, more direct ways. I was in my office, trying to sort through the mountain of paperwork, when a package arrived. It was from a former student, someone I spent countless hours helping, someone who struggled and, due to sheer persistence, eventually succeeded. Inside was an elaborate, expensive gift. It was thoughtful, yes, but the sheer opulence of it felt... off. It’s not about the money or the gifts; it’s about the learning, the growth. Now I have to think of what to do with this, how to respond without making a bigger issue out of it. All I wanted was for them to remember the lessons, not weigh me down with this kind of indebtedness.
